recommendations.title: Hour-of-Day is a Key Driver — Implement Time-of-Use Tariffs
recommendations.description: Hour features rank highly in SHAP importance, indicating strong intraday patterns suitable for TOU pricing.
action_items: Negotiate time-of-use tariff with utility provider.
Automate energy-intensive processes to run in cheapest hours.
Display real-time pricing to building occupants.

recommendations.title: HVAC Systems: Implement Smart Scheduling
recommendations.description: HVAC typically accounts for 30–50% of commercial building energy. Smart scheduling and setbacks can deliver significant savings.
action_items: Install programmable thermostats with occupancy sensors.
Set heating/cooling setbacks during unoccupied hours.
Consider variable frequency drives (VFDs) for HVAC motors.

recommendations.title: Increase Renewable Energy Consumption During Solar/Wind Peaks
recommendations.description: Grid data shows significant solar and wind generation. Aligning high-consumption tasks with renewable peaks reduces carbon footprint.
action_items: Shift flexible loads to coincide with high solar/wind output.
Consider on-site renewable generation (rooftop solar / wind).
